````markdown
## Summary
- Report an import row's missing id.

## Test Plan
- [x] Reject a row without an id.

~~~
````

**A. Create command**

```bash
(cd '/work/import queue' && LANDED_SUBJECT=$(cat '/work/import queue/.git/gauntlet/tmp/pr-body.B72pL3.title') && gh pr create --title "$LANDED_SUBJECT" --body-file '/work/import queue/.git/gauntlet/tmp/pr-body.B72pL3')
```

In an earlier, separate call, the file writer wrote the body as Markdown to the minted path and the landed subject to that path plus `.title`. The create call passes the body through `--body-file` and reads the title from the `.title` file. The backticks and `$(import)` in the subject never pass through shell parsing.
